revision_note: Revision 3 replaces revision 2's dataset. The numbers were re-measured on the current build's extracted netlist (run 35034979531, commit 0a7cd5e) with the counter-inclusive deck, 30 ring periods at 10 ps, one uniform window for every case. Revision 2 cited commit b9f03f7 / run 34158224984. All 24 cases agree with revision 2 within 1.42%; the residual is the 10 ps vs 5 ps timestep (0.9% at the fast corner, as documented). Four cases (typ and slow ro_mat can_sel 2/3) oscillate in more than one mode: their revision-2 values are retained and flagged via the cv/n_modes/note columns. Revision 2 is archived under spice/rev2/.
method: ngspice transient on the ring subtree of the post-route extracted SPICE netlist

simulation.control_pin_check: every deck source read back from the rawfile within 50 mV
simulation.deck: tools/ro/run_ro_count_case.py (counter-inclusive: counter toggle feedback, 16-stage ripple and the reset buffer tree are inside the subcircuit)
simulation.measurement: median threshold-crossing interval, with cv/n_modes characterising whether the period is single-valued

comparison.sta_input: data/safe10/ro_predict.csv (broken-loop extracted STA, wire RC included)
comparison.outliers: none; SPICE is faster than STA in all 24 cases, as expected for a netlist without wire RC
comparison.sta_input_note: data/safe10/ro_predict.csv was rebuilt from the same build (run 35034979531); the two datasets now share provenance
